title: Payment Arrangements Payment Methods and Authorization — Operations Matrix
content:
Payment operations keeps one matrix of the payment-method and authorization figures for each type of Payment Arrangements: how long the consumer has to authorize a new plan, whether a recorded telephone authorization suffices, which collection methods the type admits, the card-debit ceiling, the revocation notice for scheduled debits, and how many changes of payment method the type allows in any rolling 12 months.

## Authorization

| Arrangement type | Authorization window (calendar days after creation) | Recorded telephone authorization suffices |
|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 2 | Yes |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 3 | Yes |
| Standard Installment Plan | 5 | Yes |
| Extended Installment Plan | 5 | No |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | 7 | No |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | 10 | No |

Where a recorded telephone authorization does not suffice, the consumer signs electronically.

## Collection methods

| Arrangement type | Automatic debit required | Card automatic debit allowed | Card debit ceiling per installment (USD) | Manual payment allowed | Retail cash payment network allowed | Weekly schedule must be on automatic debit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | No | Yes | 2500.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | No | Yes | 2500.00 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Standard Installment Plan | No | Yes | 2000.00 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Extended Installment Plan | Yes | Yes | 1500.00 | No | No | No |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | Yes | No | 0.00 | No | No | No |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | No | Yes | 500.00 | Yes | Yes | No |

A card ceiling of 0.00 appears where card automatic debit is not offered.

## Revocation notice and payment-method changes

| Arrangement type | Revocation notice before a scheduled debit (business days) | Payment-method changes per rolling 12 months |
|---|---|---|
| Promise-to-Pay Arrangement | 3 | 1 |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | 3 | 2 |
| Standard Installment Plan | 3 | 3 |
| Extended Installment Plan | 3 | 3 |
| Long-Term Installment Plan | 3 | 4 |
| Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan | 3 | 4 |

## Reading the matrix

- The Long-Term Installment Plan admits automatic ACH debit only: automatic debit is required, card debit is not offered and manual payment is not allowed.
- The Extended Installment Plan admits automatic ACH debit, or automatic card debit of installments no larger than 1500.00.
- Hypothetical case: a Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan with a regular installment of 620.00 is above that type's card ceiling of 500.00, so card automatic debit is not available for it; automatic ACH debit and manual payment remain within the matrix.
